title: Upstream (source-wide) supply loss, then return
description: The simulated source fails: every node loses supply at once. This is not a break pattern (no node has supply upstream of a dead one), so the virtual controller does not trip. Supply returns after 20 s.
what_to_look_for: Feeder: INTERRUPTION SUSPECTED with location 'Source or first section – cannot distinguish'. No section is claimed.
Event type SOURCE_INTERRUPTION_SUSPECTED; isolation not requested.
When supply returns: RECOVERY CHECK (10 s), RESTORED, then NORMAL; the event closes.
